newsitem.title: USA: ADM to open three vegetable oil refineries.
newsitem.headline: ADM to open three vegetable oil refineries.

text.p: Archer Daniels Midland Co will open three new vegetable oil refineries this summer and fall, an ADM official said Wednesday at a meeting of the National Institute of Oilseed Products here.
The refineries will be located in Valdosta, Ga.; Mankato, Minn., and Enderlin, N.D., Edward J. Campbell, with ADM in Decatur, Ill., told Reuters after the meeting.
All three refineries are being built at existing crushing plants, he said.
The Valdosta facility will refine soybean oil and cottonseed oil, while the Mankato facility will refine soybean oil and the Enderlin facility will refine sunflowerseed and canola oil, Campbell said.
ADM also plans to increase its cottonseed oil crushing capacity at the Valdosta facility, he said.

On Wednesday, ADM announced it will close its Clarksdale, Miss., soybean processing plant for the rest of the crop year, which ends September 1, and has scaled back crush rates at its Taylorville, Ill.; Little Rock, Ark.; and Mexico, Mo., plants
